Extracted with the Rust syntax parser from [`src/capabilities.rs`](https://github.com/chalk-ai/chalk-router/blob/main/src/capabilities.rs). These are source contracts, including Serde attributes, **not a universal provider JSON Schema**. Native envelopes can retain additional fields; compatibility codecs can reject them. Read the [endpoint guides](/reference/http/) for dispatch behavior.

Type notation: `Option<T>` can be absent/null; `Vec<T>` is an array; maps are JSON objects; `Value` and `SchemaJson` retain JSON. `rename` determines wire names, `flatten` adds properties at the containing level, `tag`/`untagged` control enum encoding, `default` permits omission, and `skip_serializing_if` affects output. Container attributes apply to every field. Semantic constraints are enforced separately by handlers and providers.
